title: You stream it. Can you write it off?
label: Creator Tax Check

hook.sub: Streaming it? Read this before tax time.

beats.text: You stream it. Can you *write it off?*

items.l: "I play it on stream, so it's a business expense"
Streaming is a business run to make a profit

beats.kicker: All of this is income, 1099 or not

beats.note: Log payouts, save receipts, track business use.

captions.instagram:
Played GTA VI yet? 🎮 If you're streaming it, read this before tax time.

Myth: "I play it on stream, so the game is a business expense."
Fact: only if streaming is a business you run to make a profit, and only the business-use share. Playing for fun is personal.

✔️ Every tip, sub, bit, ad share and sponsor dollar is income, 1099 or not.
✔️ Gifted products you get in exchange for content count too.
✔️ Self-employment tax starts at $400 of net profit.

Sources: IRS hobby vs business factors, Topic 420, Topic 554. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
